newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia keeps Helsinki HEX above 3,000, others slide.
newsitem.headline: Nokia keeps Helsinki HEX above 3,000, others slide.

text.p: Finnish shares were hit by profit-taking Tuesday afternoon after starting at life-highs, with other European bourses off highs and Wall Street starting lower, but the broad picture was supported by Nokia's strength.

The HEX general index stayed above the 3,000-point mark all session and closed at 3,006.36, up almost one percent but off its 3,019.61 point intra-session record. Volume was 737 million markka with 38 percent in Nokia.
"The fact that we passed the 3,000 level was probably a sell signal for some players," said one broker, but he added that the HEX would stay above 3,000 if supported by Wall Street.
The FOX derivatives and portfolio benchmark index closed at 1.051.58, up 0.56 percent.

Among forestries, UPM-Kymmene closed at 115.00 markka, down 1.00 markka, Metsa-Serla was down 0.10 markka at 42.90, but Enso reversed losses that came after its 1996 results on Monday -- up 0.60 markka at 45.90 "once investors had digested the report," said one broker.
Pharmaceuticals wholesaler Tamro rose after it broke resistance at 34 markka to close up 0.60 at 34.60, though some brokers were disappointed with its 0.90 markka dividend.
Insurer Sampo added 3.00 markka to 455.00 as investors switched from rival Pohjola which fell 0.55 markka to 143.70 in lively dealings.
Paper machine maker Valmet was also active, falling 0.30 markka to 91.00. "Investors' views on Valmet have probably changed," one broker said.
The share has risen from 80.00 markka this year but has in the last two weeks inched down from a 97.10 peak.
